subject: Commit optimization plan + QBR availability (Orbital Health)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@orbitalhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit optimization plan + QBR availability (Orbital Health)

Hi Sophie / Orbital team,

Thanks again for the productive conversation last week. As we move toward your May 31 contract renewal window, I wanted to kick off a short, practical plan focused on:

- aligning committed capacity for the next 12 months,
- documenting any term or pricing changes needed for your finance review, and
- scheduling the QBR where we’ll present the uplift impact and run a short SLO discussion.

Proposed next steps (high level):
1) We’ll share a mutual action plan with milestone owners and delivery dates (attached draft).
2) Ben will provide a short technical note confirming how the extra vGPU pool would be provisioned and estimated latency impact.
3) We’ll coordinate a 60-minute QBR in the week of May 20–24 to review capacity, unit economics, and the proposed amendment.

Can you confirm two 60-minute windows you prefer that week (in PDT)? If procurement needs an early read on the amendment, happy to route a redline-first PDF to procurement@orbitalhealth.com today.

Attachments: Orbital_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (draft)

Thanks — I’ll keep this tight.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@orbitalhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2029 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit optimization plan + QBR availability (Orbital Health)

Jasmine —

Thanks for the summary and the draft MAP. A few quick notes from our side:

- We are targeting a 40% uplift in committed units for peak hours, but need an estimate on the marginal cost per 1k tokens at that tier.
- Procurement would like to see an amendment they can circulate internally before the QBR (pricing table + term language).
- For meeting availability: May 21 10:00–11:00 PDT or May 23 14:00–15:00 PDT would work for the PM and finance leads.

If you can surface the amendment PDF and a short cost delta sheet before EOD Thursday, procurement can start their internal review.

Appreciate it — Sophie
Sophie Chen
Head of Platform Operations, Orbital Health
sophie.chen@orbitalhealth.com

Date: Wed, 8 May 2029 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit optimization plan + QBR availability (Orbital Health)

Sophie — quick technical note to help with the cost delta table Jasmine requested:

- If Orbital moves to +40% committed peak units, the most cost-effective configuration is to add a reserved vGPU pool with auto-burst disabled for non-production workloads.
- Expected token-cost delta (approx): +$0.018 per 1k tokens at committed tier vs current on-demand. This is an estimate — final numbers in the attached Proposed_Amendment_v1.pdf.
- Latency impact: <10% median throughput change on 2x sequence length workloads; we’ll validate in the pre-QBR dry run.

I’ve attached a redlineable amendment and updated the MAP with delivery owners and milestone dates. Karthik — would you confirm infra lead availability for a 30-minute dry run the week of May 13?

Attachments: Proposed_Amendment_v1.pdf; Orbital_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (updated)

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@orbitalhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@orbitalhealth.com>

Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit optimization plan + QBR availability (Orbital Health)

Great — appreciate the quick turnaround, Sophie.

Confirming next steps and schedule:
- QBR booked: May 21, 10:00–11:00 PDT. Invite to follow after procurement scans the attached amendment.
- Dry run for the capacity validation: May 14, 11:00–11:30 PDT (Karthik, Ben, Sophie — please confirm).
- Deliverables before QBR: final amendment PDF for procurement, updated MAP with milestone owners (attached), and a short one-pager showing the cost delta.

Procurement: I’ve attached Proposed_Amendment_v1.pdf for internal review. Let me know if you want a tracked-changes Word doc; we can produce that by EOD Friday.

If that all looks good I’ll set the calendar invites and a shared Drive folder for the QBR artifacts.

Thanks team — looking forward to closing this smoothly.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
